{{Top}}
[[File:Explosives-NEGWT.png|thumb|right|300px|A CryoBan, fragmentation, and glop grenade]]
'''Grenade''' was a catch-all term for any self-contained explosive device, usually thrown by hand, but sometimes launched from a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]], which was useful in [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] combat.
